description: Get one mine controller's record from MSHA open government data. The record sums hours, injuries as reported to MSHA, violations and penalties by year across the mines it held for the most days of each year. It lists the mines it has controlled, showing the first 50 by name and the dates it held each. The tool returns only companies; MSHA controllers that are individual persons have no record here.

controller_id.description: MSHA controller ID, as shown on a mine record.

name: get_mine_controller
title: Get a mine controller's record
